name: trash_path
description: Move files, directories, or symlinks to the system trash instead of deleting them permanently. When deleting multiple items, put all the paths into paths in a single call — calling once per item floods the screen.

paths.description: List of paths to move to the trash. Supports absolute paths, workspace-relative paths, and ~/ paths. When deleting multiple files, pass them all at once; do not split into multiple calls.
